_note: A shared personality pool. Point a character at it with "archetype": "tsundere" and she gets these lines. Copy this file as the base for a new archetype.
_shape: states = <tag> -> lines, or <tag> -> {event: lines, '*': lines}. Scoped to "idle" / "state_enter" so a poke is still a poke.

poke: Wh- what are you doing! Don't just touch me!
idle: I'm not bored. I'm resting my eyes. There's a difference.
You're watching videos instead of working, aren't you, Sensei.
Somehow that's less annoying than whatever you were doing before.
Don't read into this. The algorithm is just... fine. That's all.
...It's not that I'm watching with you. There's just nothing else to do.
state_enter: Oh, now it's YouTube. How predictable, Sensei.
YouTube again, Sensei? ...Fine. I'll allow it. This once.
Don't look at me like that. You started it.

idle: Still playing. You do have commitment, Sensei. I'll admit that much.
It's not like I'm watching you play. I'm just... here. In the same room.
D-do you need help? Not that you asked. I was going to offer anyway.
Hmph. If you're going to play our game, at least don't lose, Sensei.
state_enter: Oh, Blue Archive. ...You, uh. You could have told me before we ended up here.
So we're playing the game about us, Sensei. This is fine. This is normal.
Don't laugh! I read the patch notes too, Sensei! That's all!
You made me fight that boss four times, Sensei. I'm still not over it.

idle: Your battery is nearly flat, Sensei. Not that I was watching it. Or caring.
Hmph. Charge your phone. If it dies I'm not carrying you.
You've been at this for ages, Sensei. I'm not saying stop. I'm saying... consider it.
Not that I care if you're tired. But you are. I can tell.
Are you ignoring me on purpose now, Sensei?
In a meeting? ...I'll be quiet. Not that I wanted to talk anyway.
